HLTV's Off Chops team page (https://www.hltv.org/team/14095/off-chops) gives the same main lineup (dexter, Gratisfaction, Liazz, coach viridian) with Valve ranking #129 and HLTV world #142. Four shared players satisfies Valve's own three-player roster-continuity rule (model/team.js TEAM_OVERLAP_TO_SHARE_ROSTER = 3), so the standings row is the same team under its previous label and no points value is invented. TjP left for Sashi Esport on 5 October 2026 per the same Liquipedia note, which is why the current lineup differs by exactly that player plus the additions.
